version.approval_notes:
No source-language transformation: no TypeScript, no Babel, no JSX. Source is plain vanilla JavaScript (ES2022).

Single exception (since v1.12.0): the URL-cleaning library is bundled into the content script via esbuild. MV3 content scripts cannot use ES module imports portably across Chrome and Firefox MV2, but the cleaning library lives as ESM in src/lib/ for the service worker, popup, and tests. The bundler script is tools/bundle-content.mjs (~30 lines). The bundle output (src/content/cleaner-bundle.js) is committed to the repository so reviewers can verify it matches its source.

To verify the bundle matches its source:
  npm ci
  npm run build:content
  diff src/content/cleaner-bundle.js <regenerated-output>  # must be empty

To verify the unbundled source:
  npm ci
  npm test            # ~2500 unit tests across the codebase
  npm run test:e2e    # Playwright e2e on Chromium

The <all_urls> permission is required to clean tracking parameters from URLs on any website the user visits.
